findings.title: Canonical four-subagent pattern is documented but not live
evidence: Pack 13 requires Context Preparer, Source Augmenter, Output Refiner, and Memo Drafter as invocable subagents with schemas/evals.
skills/subagents/*/SKILL.md files exist.
backend/agents contains deep_research, firewall, and langgraph only; no backend runtime dirs for context_preparer, source_augmenter, output_refiner, or memo_drafter.
src/lib/tools/context-provider.ts subagent() returns a descriptor object, not an Agent Engine invocation.
docs/audits/2026-05-06-COMPREHENSIVE.md and AI_PROVIDER_INVENTORY both acknowledge LangGraph/subagent runtime gaps.
findings.impact: Architecture claims that every subagent invocation is logged, costed, traced, and runtime-constrained are not yet true for the four canonical tool-context subagents.
findings.recommendation: Implement runtime subagent directories, typed input/output schemas, eval sets, and an audited ctx.subagent invocation path before marking Pack 13/Agent Platform posture complete.

findings.title: Cost/token/model telemetry is structurally present but not populated end to end
evidence: withCalibration creates and completes tool_runs.

withCalibration currently calls completeToolRun(toolRunId) without token/cost/model result values.
cost_ledger migration exists, but no cost_ledger writer was found.

findings.impact: Per-call cost, token, and model evidence required by the architecture cannot be treated as production-complete even though route calibration passes.
findings.recommendation: Capture AI SDK usage/model metadata at provider call boundaries, pass it into completeToolRun, and add the missing cost_ledger writer plus an audit that verifies non-zero telemetry on fixture runs.

findings.title: Multiple same-name Agent Engine deployments create binding ambiguity
evidence: REST inventory found three ReasoningEngine resources with displayName praxis_deep_research_v1.
Cloud Run references VERTEX_AGENT_ENGINE_ID from secret praxis-vertex-adk-engine-id.
The secret exists and has one enabled version, but payload was not read and no session call was made.
findings.impact: Production may be correctly bound, but an auditor cannot tell from metadata alone which deployed engine is active; duplicate engines also make cleanup and trace attribution harder.
findings.recommendation: Record the active engine ID in a non-secret deployment ledger, tag superseded engines, and add a read-only audit that compares Cloud Run's secret value to the active ReasoningEngine inventory when owner-approved.
